execution.implementation: A genuine Rosalind launcher call recorded task-chooser readiness; experimental sotorasib and adagrasib poses were analyzed locally with covalent-link records and fixed-CID PubChem descriptors, and no Rosalind scientific job or new docking was run

observations: The genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call returned the exact message 'Rosalind Workbench is ready. Choose a research task in the app.' and ready=true; it opened only the task chooser.
PDB LINK records place the Cys12-ligand covalent bonds at 1.81 angstrom in 6OIM and 1.69 angstrom in 6USZ.
The 4.0-angstrom analysis found 17 KRAS contact residues for sotorasib and 22 for adagrasib.
All 17 sotorasib contact residues also occur in the adagrasib contact set, giving a Jaccard value of 0.7727.
interpretation: The deposited inhibitors share a common switch-II pocket environment and covalent Cys12 attachment, while the adagrasib pose has additional contacts at this cutoff.
limitations: The Rosalind launcher observation does not show that docking, reaction modeling, or another scientific job was executed.
No docking, reaction modeling, binding kinetics, cellular assay, or clinical analysis was performed.
Covalent LINK geometry and static contact counts do not measure chemical reactivity, potency, or selectivity.
PDB bound-form ligands and PubChem parent compounds are retained as distinct representations.

provenance.note: The local scripts retain covalent records and compute contact, overlap, descriptor, summary, and preview artifacts from public data; the separate Rosalind observation records chooser readiness and no scientific job.

reproduction: Call mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open with task_context 'Document the KRAS G12C ligand-pose showcase; open the task chooser only and do not start a scientific job.' and record the exact response separately as outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json.
Run python scripts/analyze_case.py from the case directory.
Optionally run python scripts/fetch_public_inputs.py first to refresh current RCSB revisions.
Verify Cys12 LINK records and the no-new-docking statement in analysis-summary.json.

environment.data: public RCSB PDB and PubChem records
